# Clean the wheels

[All care guides](README.md)

## Roomba 600 and 700 series · Roomba 800 and 900 series

![Clean the wheels](../img/underside_600_900--wheel.svg)

**What it does**

The front caster and the drive wheels carry the robot. Hair or grit in them makes it pull to one side or stop.

**How to**

1. Turn the robot over.
2. Pull the front caster out of its socket and take the wheel off its axle.
3. Remove hair and dirt from the wheel, the axle and the socket.
4. Turn the drive wheels by hand and clear anything that catches, then push the caster back in until it clicks.

> **Note** Do not pull the drive wheels out: they are not meant to be removed.

## Roomba s series

![Clean the wheels](../img/underside_s--wheel.svg)

**What it does**

The caster wheel at the back and the drive wheels carry the robot. Hair or grit in them makes it pull to one side or stop.

**How to**

1. Turn the robot over.
2. Pull the caster wheel at the back out of its socket and take the wheel off its axle.
3. Remove hair and dirt from the wheel, the axle and the socket.
4. Turn the drive wheels by hand and clear anything that catches, then push the caster back in until it clicks.

> **Note** Do not pull the drive wheels out: they are not meant to be removed.
